research_requirement: These dated official and archive references are verified as retrieval leads, not as final evidence for the candidate geometries. Acquire and retain complete source bytes (or archival record references and certified copies), page/map identifiers, scale/coverage, issuing authority, effective/document dates, license/access terms and receipts before asserting exact water or inland boundary classification. The current handoff retains source product custody and reference metadata, not the full MAWLR/MINEA/archive document bodies.
